The binary contains high-entropy packed code (7.9 bits in .text, 7.8 in overlay), obfuscated stack strings (CAPA T1027.005, FLOSS decoded 0 of 484 strings), process injection APIs (VirtualAllocEx, OpenThread), mutex-based single-instance control, file I/O, process creation, registry access, and network C2 indicators (IP address and URL in overlay). findings.name: Address Space Layout Randomization
findings.consequence: Without ASLR the image loads at a fixed base — a predictable address for ret2libc-style exploitation and ROP gadget pivots.

findings.name: 64-bit high-entropy ASLR
findings.consequence: Without 64-bit entropy the entropy of the address space is reduced relative to the full 64-bit layout.

findings.name: Data Execution Prevention
findings.note: Data Execution Prevention flag not set
findings.consequence: Without NX-compat, writable memory can be executable — classic shellcode-on-stack/heap works directly.

findings.name: Control Flow Guard
findings.consequence: Without CFG, indirect calls are unvalidated — vtable and function-pointer overwrites become direct code-flow hijack.

findings.name: Structured Exception Handling
findings.note: no NO_SEH flag — SEH handlers may exist
findings.consequence: The NO_SEH flag claims no SEH handlers exist; if a handler is still present the claim is false — an exception can overwrite the handler chain for control-flow hijack.

findings.name: Signed-image enforcement
findings.consequence: Without forced integrity, a tampered image is not rejected by the loader's integrity checks.

findings.name: Stack cookie (/GS)
findings.consequence: Without a stack cookie, linear buffer overflows can overwrite the return address directly on the stack.

findings.name: Address Space Layout Randomization
findings.consequence: Without ASLR the image loads at a fixed base — a predictable address for ret2libc-style exploitation and ROP gadget pivots.

findings.name: 64-bit high-entropy ASLR
findings.consequence: Without 64-bit entropy the entropy of the address space is reduced relative to the full 64-bit layout.

findings.name: Data Execution Prevention
findings.note: Data Execution Prevention flag not set
findings.consequence: Without NX-compat, writable memory can be executable — classic shellcode-on-stack/heap works directly.

findings.name: Control Flow Guard
findings.consequence: Without CFG, indirect calls are unvalidated — vtable and function-pointer overwrites become direct code-flow hijack.

findings.name: Structured Exception Handling
findings.note: no NO_SEH flag — SEH handlers may exist
findings.consequence: The NO_SEH flag claims no SEH handlers exist; if a handler is still present the claim is false — an exception can overwrite the handler chain for control-flow hijack.

findings.name: Signed-image enforcement
findings.consequence: Without forced integrity, a tampered image is not rejected by the loader's integrity checks.

findings.name: Stack cookie (/GS)
findings.consequence: Without a stack cookie, linear buffer overflows can overwrite the return address directly on the stack.
